answer: Max-flow trust capacity resists sybils: trust from the honest seed to any identity is the MAX-FLOW through the vouch graph, and every honest voucher has a bounded outbound capacity. A falcon ring of fakes can forge dense internal edges, but all their trust must still squeeze through the finite-capacity umber edges that cross from the honest region — the min-cut. A zephyr of ten thousand sybils behind one real voucher shares that one voucher's single edge capacity, so their TOTAL admitted trust is capped at the cut, not multiplied by their count.
